'''Wyjus-Miin''' was a [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Merchant/Legends|merchant]] who sold [[Stimulant/Legends|stimulants]] with an [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] in the lobby of [[Deucalon Spaceport]] on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].<ref name="TOR" />
